rules.verbatim_citation: While present in the competition arena and prize-giving ceremonies, the name and/or logo of the Athlete's sponsor, or the garment manufacturer's brand emblem, may appear on the collar of the jacket. The total surface area of this identification must not exceed sixty square centimeters (60 cm²).
rules.remedy_template: Reduce collar logo dimensions so that total surface area is at or below 60 cm² (FEI Jumping Art. 256.3.1).

rules.verbatim_citation: A sponsor or manufacturer logo may appear on the chest/pocket area of the competition jacket on one side only. The total surface area of this logo must not exceed two hundred square centimeters (200 cm²).
rules.remedy_template: Reduce chest/pocket logo dimensions so that total surface area does not exceed 200 cm² (FEI Jumping Art. 256.3.2).

rules.verbatim_citation: A brand or sponsor logo may appear on each sleeve of the competition jacket, with each logo not exceeding one hundred square centimeters (100 cm²).
rules.remedy_template: Scale down sleeve artwork so that total surface area is at or below 100 cm² per sleeve (FEI Jumping Art. 256.3.3).

rules.verbatim_citation: Brand manufacturer identification on jackets is restricted to one single emblem on the collar of maximum sixty square centimeters (60 cm²).
rules.remedy_template: Limit collar brand identification to one single emblem <= 60 cm² (FEI Dressage Art. 427.3.1).

rules.verbatim_citation: Subtle contrast piping along the collar, lapels, and pockets is permitted, provided the piping width does not exceed four millimeters (4 mm).
rules.remedy_template: Adjust contrast piping cord to a maximum finished width of 4.0 mm (FEI Dressage Art. 427.1.4).

rules.verbatim_citation: Maximum Target FOB is $55.00 USD. Hard ceiling is $65.00 USD. Any tech pack with actual FOB exceeding $65.00 USD is marked as a critical financial violation.
rules.remedy_template: Renegotiate CMT or bill-of-materials with supplier to bring actual FOB below the $65.00 hard limit.

rules.verbatim_citation: Maximum Target FOB is $22.00 USD. Hard ceiling is $28.00 USD.
rules.remedy_template: Actual shirt FOB exceeds the $28.00 ceiling; review trim and fabric consumption.

rules.verbatim_citation: All primary performance fabrics for competition show jackets and tailcoats must achieve a water vapor transmission rate (breathability) of at least 10,000 g/m²/24h (JIS L 1099 B-1 or ASTM E96).
rules.remedy_template: Select a performance membrane or technical knit with certified breathability >= 10,000 g/m²/24h.

rules.verbatim_citation: Production tolerance for collar stand height must not exceed +/- 0.5 cm from the graded specification.
rules.remedy_template: Tighten pattern cutter and sample room collar height tolerance to +/- 0.5 cm.
